# GAFFL

> > GAFFL is a travel companion matching platform that connects travelers worldwide to share trips and costs across destinations in North America, Europe, Asia, and beyond.

GAFFL enables solo travelers and groups to find travel buddies in specific cities, airports, and regions, facilitating cost-sharing arrangements for trips. The platform covers major destinations including New York City, London, Berlin, Mexico City, and locations across France, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Iceland, and Australia.
